title: Credit Balances and Patient Refunds — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Policy.** A coverage account of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility whose patient balance stands below 0.00 carries a credit owed to the patient.

## Clauses

1. **Automatic or on request.** A credit of at least the class's automatic refund threshold is refunded without a request; a smaller credit is refunded only when the patient asks for it through a refund request.
2. **Amount and route.** The refund amount is the whole credit, sent through the payment method of the payment that created it and applied to that payment entry; a credit created by several payments is refunded against the most recent of them first.
3. **Other accounts first.** Before refunding, the credit is first applied to any open charge on the patient's other coverage accounts, and only what remains is refunded.
4. **Once per payment.** A payment entry that has already been refunded is never refunded again. This is read from the refunds already recorded against that payment entry.
5. **Timing.** The refund is issued within the class's refund period, in calendar days, after the credit arose or the request was received.

The refund amount equals the credit itself: a balance of less than 0.00 gives a refund of that balance with its sign removed, and a balance of 0.00 or more gives no refund.

## Illustrations (hypothetical; threshold taken as 5.00)

| Account balance | Open charges on the patient's other accounts | Refunded | Requires a refund request |
|---|---|---|---|
| minus 12.00 | none | 12.00 | no |
| minus 12.00 | 7.50 open on another account | 4.50 (after 7.50 is applied to that charge) | the remaining credit is below 5.00, so yes |
| minus 3.00 | none | 3.00 | yes |
| 0.00 | — | nothing | — |

When a credit of 12.00 was created by two payments, the refund is applied against the more recent of the two payment entries first, through that payment's method.
